name: E2_calibration_on_E1_designs
title: Pre-freeze calibration of the E2 predictor on the E1 designs with the E1 draws (exploratory data; not part of the E2 test)

laws.supply: dx = (G/dG) ln[(D - a delta)/(D - delta)], delta = V_sw,k - V_sw,nom
laws.dac_remap: dx = (G/dG) [eps(aI) - eps(I)], eps(I) = sum_p s_p(I) z_p + lambda(I) delta, s_p = -d lnI/d mm_p, lambda = -d lnI/d V_DS, at the nominal gate voltage for current I = G D
laws.rms: predicted rms (LSB) = 15 sqrt(mean over theta of E[dx^2]); E[dx_supply^2] = (G/dG)^2 E[ln^2 r]; E[dx_remap^2] = (G/dG)^2 {sum_p [s_p(aI)-s_p(I)]^2 + [lambda(aI)-lambda(I)]^2 sigma_delta^2}; sigma_delta^2 = sum_p (dV_sw/dmm_p)^2

predictor.mm_step: central difference with mm_p = +1 and -1 (one PDK sigma)
predictor.supply_expectation: trapezoid rule over delta in [-6 sigma, 6 sigma] with 4001 points; delta >= 0.95 D dropped and the Gaussian weights renormalized
predictor.inputs_allowed: nominal and +-1 sigma perturbed single-device simulations only (no Monte Carlo, no circuit-level result)

models.note: tt files are byte-identical to the E1 subset; ss and ff are patched the same way (src/pcm_acam/sky130_models.py)

circuit.criterion: bound = V_DL at which V_X = V_sw; V_sw = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V (same as E1)
circuit.v_sl_rule: V_SL,nom = V_sw,nom(condition) + D (the bias generator tracks the pull-down's corner and temperature)
circuit.programming: threshold verify: G_k(theta) = I_div,k(M0(theta)) / (V_SL,nom - V_sw,k); primary evaluation without clipping (the laws describe the circuit, not the PCM range); clipped to [0, 25] uS as a secondary evaluation

condition_note: the nine E1 designs (P1-P4, S1-S5), tt, 27 C; same circuit, programming and drift as E2; E1 draws (rng_stream 0) so that the result can be compared with the E1 run; used only to see how well the predictor works on known data before E2 is frozen
feasibility_rule: decided in the predict phase from nominal curves only: a condition is dropped before the Monte Carlo phase if the nominal bound at G = 30 uS exceeds 1.75 V, or if the nominal input map cannot be computed on x in [-0.12, 1.0]

mismatch.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, rng_stream]); z_div then z_pd (300 x 4 each); rng_stream 0 = the E1 draws

metric: input-referred bound error in LSB, rms over all (instance, theta) pairs, theta_j = j/15, j = 0..15
x_grid_note: input grid of the DAC maps; upper end 1.6 (was 1.12 before the smoke test, where the dac_remap estimate reached x_eff = 1.15 > 1.12 for condition C1 and those pairs were counted as invalid by C5)
phases: predict -> mc (same program as E2); the decision fields are computed but have no meaning for the E2 test

checks.C1: full-branch DC simulation equals the I-V inversion for the nominal cell (G in {2.5, 12.5, 22.5} uS, V_SL,nom and V_SL(1y)) within 0.05 mV, every condition
checks.C2: zero mismatch: |error| <= 0.001 LSB for dac_remap, supply, ideal, every condition and time
checks.C3: ideal node |error| <= 0.001 LSB on all valid pairs (threshold verify reproduces the target)
checks.C4: Monte Carlo sigma of V_sw within max(0.15, 3/sqrt(2(n-1))) relative of the predicted sigma_delta, every condition
checks.C5: I-V curves monotone over the used range; pairs without a valid bound <= 1 % per condition, setting and node
checks.C6: pull-down V_sw,nom ordering: ss > tt > ff at 27 C, and -40 C > 27 C > 85 C at tt (pd_min)
checks.C7: nominal divider curve of the Monte Carlo phase equals that of the predict phase (max |d ln I| <= 1e-9) for every condition
checks.stop_rule: any failed check stops the run before the criteria are evaluated

criteria.tolerance: a prediction passes if |pred - sim| <= max(0.15 sim, 0.02 LSB)
criteria.A1: setting pdk, 1y, nodes dac_remap and supply: at least 90 % of the (feasible condition, node) pairs pass
criteria.A2: setting pdk, 1y: in every feasible condition whose predicted gap |pred_dac - pred_supply| >= 0.2 max(pred_dac, pred_supply), the predicted better node is the simulated better node
criteria.A3: settings div_only (dac_remap) and pd_only (dac_remap, supply), 1y: at least 90 % pass (secondary, reported, not part of the decision)
criteria.decision: the laws are validated as a design-time predictor if A1 and A2 both hold; otherwise not validated, and the failing conditions are reported
criteria.secondary: 1d and 30d, clipped programming (g_max 25 uS), per-theta profiles: reported only
